statement: For all natural numbers n and k with k ≤ n, the binomial coefficient n C′ k (the number of k-element subsets of an n-element set, equal to n! / (k! (n−k)!)) is symmetric: choosing k elements out of n is equivalent to discarding n − k of them, so n C′ (n − k) = n C′ k.
